artworks.title: Jason with the Golden Fleece
artworks.description: Thorvaldsen's Jason with the Golden Fleece — the voyage's prize, the ram's gold brought home from Colchis.

artworks.title: Jason and the Dragon (Douris cup)
artworks.description: The Douris cup: Jason and the Dragon — the Colchian ordeal at the end of the Argo's eastward run.

artworks.title: Meeting of Jason and King Aeëtes
artworks.description: Carracci's Meeting of Jason and King Aeëtes — the Colchian court that sets the impossible trials.

artworks.title: Jason and Medea
artworks.description: Moreau's Jason and Medea — the enchantress who makes the voyage survive Aeëtes' tests.

films.title: Jason and the Argonauts
films.description: Harryhausen's voyage — clashing rocks, Harpies, and the Colchis dragon — remains cinema's definitive Argo.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: The Hellenistic epic of the fleece quest — Jason's crew sailing to Medea's Colchis.

popCulture.title: Jason
popCulture.description: The captain who needed the Argo and a sorceress — the voyage defines him more than the throne he sought.
